title: JsonRpcResponse
description: Formal JSON-RPC 2.0 result response envelope transmitted by the Kardenwort-Desk persistent streaming daemon over socket transport (Named Pipe on Windows, UNIX Domain Socket or loopback TCP on POSIX). Issued when an operational command completes successfully. All frames are newline-delimited UTF-8 JSON strings.

jsonrpc.description: JSON-RPC protocol version. MUST always be exactly '2.0'.

id.description: Correlation identifier copied verbatim from the client's originating request. MUST match the request 'id' exactly. MUST be null if the request 'id' was null or if this is a server-push notification frame.

result.description: Successful operation output payload. The structure varies by the originating command method. MUST be present when the command succeeded. MUST NOT be present alongside 'error'.

RenderResult.title: RenderResult
RenderResult.description: Successful response payload for the 'render' command.

output.description: Rendered HTML output. Encoded as Base64 string when output_format='base64', raw HTML when output_format='html'.

EditSaveResult.title: EditSaveResult
EditSaveResult.description: Successful response payload for the 'edit-save' command.

row_index.description: Zero-based index of the row that was updated.

RetextResult.title: RetextResult
RetextResult.description: Successful response payload for the 'retext' command.

retext_started.description: Indicates that the retext operation was accepted and background processing has begun.

status.description: Operation completion status or null when retext is asynchronous.

ReprocessResult.title: ReprocessResult
ReprocessResult.description: Successful response payload for the 'reprocess' command.

reprocess_started.description: Indicates that the reprocess operation was accepted and background processing has begun.

rows.description: Number of rows queued for reprocessing.

status.description: Synchronous completion status. Null when processing is asynchronous.

message.description: Human-readable status message, present when status='skipped'.

LookupResult.title: LookupResult
LookupResult.description: Successful response payload for the 'lookup' command.

match.description: Dictionary lookup match result object. Null if no match was found.

ExportResult.title: ExportResult
ExportResult.description: Successful response payload for the 'export' command.

show_window.description: Whether the Kardenwort window should be brought into focus.

message.description: Human-readable status message, present when status='skipped'.

MergeResult.title: MergeResult
MergeResult.description: Successful response payload for the 'merge' command.

merged_count.description: Number of new vocabulary entries merged into the target file.

duplicate_count.description: Number of duplicate entries suppressed during merge.

ShutdownResult.title: ShutdownResult
ShutdownResult.description: Successful response payload for the 'shutdown' command.

status.description: Indicates the daemon has accepted the shutdown signal and will gracefully terminate.

NotificationResult.title: NotificationResult
NotificationResult.description: Server-push asynchronous notification frame emitted by the backend daemon to broadcast real-time processing progress. Replaces file-message-queue disk polling. The 'id' in the parent response MUST be null for notifications.

rows.description: Optional row-level update payload. Structure mirrors file-message-queue row objects for backward compatibility.
